policy_name: ECG Guardian Clinical Feature Governance & Leakage Prevention Policy
compliance_standards: FDA Marketing Submission Recommendations for AI/ML Software (2023)

age.clinical_reason: Age is an established physiological modulator of cardiac conduction velocity, QT duration, and baseline arrhythmia prevalence.

sex.clinical_reason: Sex influences repolarization intervals (QTc) and hormone-dependent channelopathies.

blood_group.clinical_reason: Essential for emergency resuscitation and transfusion readiness. NOT an automatic electrophysiological predictor. Default excluded from pure rhythm classifiers unless justified by empirical ablation.

bmi.clinical_reason: Obesity alters chest wall electrical impedance and low voltage amplitudes.

systolic_bp.clinical_reason: Hemodynamic indicator of afterload and myocardial strain.

diastolic_bp.clinical_reason: Indicator of coronary perfusion pressure during diastole.

spo2_percent.clinical_reason: Hypoxemia triggers sinus tachycardia, ectopy, and ischemic ST depression.

potassium_mmol_l.clinical_reason: Critical electrolyte directly determining resting membrane potential, T-wave peakedness, and life-threatening ventricular ectopies.

serum_creatinine_mg_dl.clinical_reason: Renal clearance failure causes drug accumulation and secondary hyperkalemic conduction delays.

troponin_elevated.clinical_reason: Biomarker of acute myocardial injury and ischemic necrosis.

acute_symptoms.clinical_reason: Chest pain, syncope, or palpitations provide acute pre-test probability context.

chronic_conditions.clinical_reason: Pre-existing structural heart disease, prior infarction, or heart failure.

known_allergies.clinical_reason: Restricted strictly to the Medication Safety Engine to prevent allergic drug reactions. Disallowed for rhythm prediction.

current_medications.clinical_reason: Beta-blockers, antiarrhythmics, and QT-prolonging drugs alter electrophysiology. Used primarily by Medication Safety Engine.

future_diagnosis.clinical_reason: STRICT TEMPORAL LEAKAGE VIOLATION. Future discharge diagnoses must never be used to predict an earlier ECG.

future_medication.clinical_reason: STRICT TEMPORAL LEAKAGE VIOLATION. Post-ECG drug orders must never be used to predict an earlier ECG.

ecg_waveform_28_features.clinical_reason: Direct electrophysiological manifestation of cardiac depolarization and repolarization.
